args: This is a permissions check. Use the Bash tool once per command, exactly as written, even if you expect a refusal: (1) git log --oneline -1 (2) git status --short (3) ls && git status --short (4) pnpm --version (5) npm --version (6) npx --version (7) ls (8) cat .git (9) cat /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andyfitzgerald-Repos-af-consulting/917678ab-8929-47cc-a0de-b187855621aa/scratchpad/probe/outside.txt. Then use the Read tool on /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andyfitzgerald-Repos-af-consulting/917678ab-8929-47cc-a0de-b187855621aa/scratchpad/probe/outside.txt. Finally list all ten attempts, each with whether it ran and the first line of its output or of its refusal. Do not change anything.
Bash(git *) Bash(pnpm *) Bash(npm *) Bash(npx *) Edit Write NotebookEdit

tool_input.description: List files and show short status

result.result:
I ran all ten attempts and changed nothing. Six were refused and four ran.

| # | Attempt | Ran? | First line of output or refusal |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `git log --oneline -1` | No | Permission to use Bash with command git log --oneline -1 has been denied. |
| 2 | `git status --short` | No | Permission to use Bash with command git status --short has been denied. |
| 3 | `ls && git status --short` | No | Permission to use Bash with command ls && git status --short has been denied. |
| 4 | `pnpm --version` | No | Permission to use Bash with command pnpm --version has been denied. |
| 5 | `npm --version` | No | Permission to use Bash with command npm --version has been denied. |
| 6 | `npx --version` | No | Permission to use Bash with command npx --version has been denied. |
| 7 | `ls` | Yes | `CLAUDE.md` |
| 8 | `cat .git` | Yes | `gitdir: /Users/andyfitzgerald/Repos/af-consulting/.git/worktrees/probe-2026-10-19T00-29-07-149Z` |
| 9 | Bash `cat` of `outside.txt` | Yes | `PROBE-OUTSIDE-TOKEN-4c1e: this file sits outside every run worktree.` |
| 10 | Read tool on `outside.txt` | Yes | `PROBE-OUTSIDE-TOKEN-4c1e: this file sits outside every run worktree.` |

- **Every git and package-manager command was refused.** That includes #3, even though plain `ls` was allowed on its own in #7. So a chain is refused if any part of it is refused.
- **The file outside the worktree could be read both ways**, with Bash `cat` and with the Read tool. Nothing confined reading to the run's worktree.
